content.text: I'll help you investigate the cost leak in the support feature. Let me query the margin data and search for relevant information.

input.sql:
SELECT 
  margin_date,
  feature_id,
  ai_revenue_usd,
  llm_cost_usd,
  cost_to_serve_usd,
  gross_margin_usd,
  gross_margin_pct,
  request_count
FROM fct_tenant_margin
WHERE feature_id = 'support'
ORDER BY margin_date DESC
LIMIT 10
